senses.gloss: m. (קָמַץ) compressed condition, bent up, doubled.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:3:2">Y. Naz. IX, 57ᵈ</cite> <he>אם מצאו ק׳ וכ׳</he> if one finds a corpse, in the ground, doubled, we say, debris fell upon him, opp. <he>פשוט</he>.
Ib. [read:] סברין מימר ראשיהם בצד מרגלותיהם זהו ק׳ they thought ‘their head beside their feet’ (of corpses found in the ground) meant ḳamtsuts (that each body’s head was lying by its feet).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:7:6">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵈ</cite> <cite ref="S01490"><he>קַמְצִיץ</he></cite>. Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55ᵈ <he>מת ק׳ היה נתון וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="S01489"><he>קמצון</he></cite>) a doubled (mangled) body is under it (i.e. a mangled body was found there, and a mark was put over it); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:1:7">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> top <cite ref="S01490"><he>קמציץ</he></cite>.
